title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Bit Apps Bit…
description: Bit Apps Bit Assist versions up to 1.8.4 are affected by a DOM-based Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which can lead to the execution of malicious scripts in the context of a user's browser session.
